name: Power Plants

categories.label: Gems gathered during the game
categories.hint: Gems already in your supply; each Gem is 1 point.

categories.label: Plant endgame scoring
categories.hint: Sum of endgame scoring from plant cards in play (e.g. Snapjaw), per each card.

categories.label: Gems on patches with your Sprites
categories.hint: Claim gems from every patch where you have a Sprite; gems on patches with no Sprites are discarded.

categories.label: Field scoring
categories.hint: One value per field: size 1/2/3/4/5/6/7/8 patches = 1st 1/3/5/7/9/11/13/15, 2nd -/1/2/3/4/5/6/7; any other presence 1 point.

tiebreakers.description: Most total Sprites in the garden.
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: area-majority. Field control = most patches controlled (control = any Sprite on the patch); ties for field control go to the player holding the lowest-numbered patch in that field. Source rulebook is a Kickstarter previewer prototype (c.2022); retail rulebook not found, so values/tiebreaks may differ in the final edition and individual plant endgame effects are not itemised. Solo mode not modelled.
